design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. A technical control room for sysadmins that breaks away from generic SaaS interfaces by using stark contrasts, sharp edges, and structured grids. Color is used strictly for function and state indication.

mono.purpose: Logs, metrics, IP addresses, bot file names

surfaces.header: Solid white background, strict 1px solid black bottom border, no shadow.
surfaces.cards: Solid white background, 1px solid black border, sharp edges (rounded-none). On hover: slight `-translate-y-1` lift with a hard solid black shadow (e.g., `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]`).
surfaces.terminal: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' Look. Deep black background, neon green mono text, 1px solid border.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-none border border-transparent font-bold transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-text_main border border-border hover:bg-surface rounded-none font-bold transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-status.stopped text-white hover:bg-red-700 rounded-none border border-transparent font-bold transition-colors

components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: rounded-none, border-border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary font-mono for technical inputs.
components.tables_lists: Dense rows. High-contrast typography for data points (CPU/RAM). Status indicated by small solid geometric shapes (e.g., a green square for running, red square for stopped) instead of soft dots.
components.modals: Backdrop blur. Modal container with white background, sharp corners, 2px solid black border, and heavy drop shadow.
components.toggles: Square toggle switches. When active, fill with primary color.

animations.interaction: Fast, mechanical transitions. `transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, background-color 0.15s ease-out`
animations.logs: Smooth auto-scroll. Use monospace font with no text-wrapping for authentic terminal feel.
animations.hover: Hard shadows appearing on cards/buttons, borders thickening slightly.

icons.style: Bold or Duotone, geometric and highly legible for dense dashboards.

images.description: Abstract blue networking cables, used for the left half of the split-screen login page to establish technical/devops atmosphere.

page_specific_instructions.login: Split screen layout. Left side: cover image with dark overlay and large white typographic brand name 'BOT.CTL'. Right side: Minimalist, stark white form, highly structured, brutalist inputs.
page_specific_instructions.dashboard: Header with 'BOT.CTL' logo and user profile. Top section: 3 sharp-edged metric cards (Total CPU, Total RAM, Active Bots). Main section: Bot Manager List. Each bot row includes its name (.py file), status (Running/Stopped), CPU (%), RAM (MB), Uptime, and action group (Start/Stop, Restart, Logs, Settings, Delete).
page_specific_instructions.bot_logs_viewer: A dedicated section or full-screen modal showing raw real-time logs. Must use the 'terminal' surface style. Include a 'Clear Logs' and 'Auto-scroll' toggle.
page_specific_instructions.bot_settings: Settings view for a specific bot: configure Cron schedules (scheduled start/stop), toggle Auto-restart on crash, and view deployment path.
